Title: Ten-digit OTP login is rejected by backend phone format
Steps: Enter seeded ten-digit phone; Get OTP.
Expected: Client sends the +91-space phone format accepted by OtpRequest.
Actual: POST /auth/send-otp returns 400; no real browser authentication.

Title: Materials Required changes local state without starting backend work
Steps: Accept; arrive; complete diagnosis checklist; Materials Required; submit materials.
Expected: Backend order enters an active-work status before material creation.
Actual: Order remained ACCEPTED; material submission returned 409. API start was necessary to continue.

Title: Required after-photo step cannot be completed
Steps: Collect materials; Add photo; inspect Next.
Expected: Capture or upload required photos and continue.
Actual: Photo capture is unavailable; zero photos; Next disabled.

Title: API failure silently substitutes static sellable catalog entries
Steps: Observed catalog timeout during localhost transport disruption.
Expected: Clearly display catalog failure or distinguish offline content.
Actual: Static items and purchase controls replace runtime catalog; successful retry shows four different QA products.

Title: Authenticated Store view has focus and contrast violations
Steps: Authenticate Store; open inventory; run axe WCAG A/AA.
Expected: No aria-hidden focus or contrast violations.
